turn2.raw_reply:
L01 | Deciding whether another source could plausibly change the answer owed to the person, and which source is worth checking, still depends on the situation.
L02 | Recognizing that a person is asking for presence rather than a report, and knowing what calm attention looks like for them, stays entirely a matter of reading the person.
L03 | Which other locations or readings are plausible enough to rule out before declaring something lost, and when to stop looking, remains a call made case by case.
L04 | Whether a source is truly outside yourself and independent enough for the claim at hand still has to be decided each time.
L05 | Choosing which lessons deserve to become a permanent step, and where in the work that step belongs, remains a matter of discretion.
L06 | How much testing a stored fact needs given what rides on it, and which missing caveats would matter, is still left to the person using it.
L07 | Very little remains beyond deciding which clock and time zone are authoritative for the record being written.
L08 | How much of the actual result must be inspected before the outcome is believed depends on the stakes and the size of the work.
L09 | Whether the stated amount of evidence is enough for the use the claim will be put to still has to be weighed in context.
L10 | What counts as being beside the fix, and how far outward the checking should go, remains a matter of interpretation.
L11 | When a cause has actually been established rather than merely suggested, and when a paraphrase is needed in place of a quote, still calls for discernment.
L12 | Almost nothing remains except deciding which strings are long or critical enough that the copy-by-program rule applies.
L13 | Once the search is confirmed to have run and returned everything, whether it was broad enough to say something about the world remains an interpretive call.
L14 | Which work is important enough to need another reviewer, and which reviewer differs in the way that matters, is still chosen by discretion.
L15 | Identifying which single check is the deciding one for a given piece of work remains a matter of understanding that work.
L16 | Choosing a deliberate failure that truly represents what the test or monitor is meant to catch still requires thought about the real risk.
L17 | What observable behavior would prove that a change is in effect, and how long to watch for it, must still be decided for each setting.
